name: yf_dividends
description:
Dividend payment history for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance dividends).
Returns: {symbol, dividends: [{Date, Dividends (amount per share)}]}, oldest first, at most the first 100 payments.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Dividends and splits together: yf_actions; splits only: yf_splits; next ex-dividend date: yf_calendar; other source: openbb_dividends. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "KO"}
